::: {#exm-ce-logit-grad}

#### Checking the gradient at the logits

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
logits = mlp(x_train[:1]).detach().requires_grad_()
loss = loss_fn(logits, y_train[:1])
loss.backward()
by_theorem = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1) - nn.functional.one_hot(y_train[:1], 10)
logit_grad_gap = (logits.grad - by_theorem).abs().max().item()
print(y_train[0].item())
print(logits.grad.numpy().round(3))
print(logit_grad_gap)
```

For the first training image, a `r py$y_train[0]$item()`,
autograd's gradient at the logits matches @thm-ce-logit-grad to within `r format(py$logit_grad_gap, digits = 2)`.
Every entry is a predicted probability, near $\frac{1}{10}$,
except entry `r py$y_train[0]$item()`, the true digit, which is that probability minus 1.

:::
